description: The plot illustrates the loss values across different iterations for various models, including Vanilla, StrmLLM, and SepLLM with different configurations. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick labels at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", also has a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different model or configuration: Vanilla (purple, solid line), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid line), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid line), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid line), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid line), and SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue, solid line). All lines exhibit a decreasing trend, starting from around 3.4 loss at 0 iterations and decreasing to between 2.5 and 2.6 loss at 140,000 iterations. The Vanilla model starts at around 3.4 loss and decreases to approximately 2.5 at 140,000 iterations. The StrmLLM (n=64) model starts at around 3.4 loss and decreases to approximately 2.65 at 140,000 iterations. The SepLLM (n=64) model starts at around 3.25 loss and decreases to approximately 2.5 at 140,000 iterations. The SepLLM (n=64, H) model starts at around 3.2 loss and decreases to approximately 2.5 at 140,000 iterations. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) model starts at around 3.2 loss and decreases to approximately 2.52 at 140,000 iterations. The SepLLM (n=128) model starts at around 3.3 loss and decreases to approximately 2.6 at 140,000 iterations.
